spec_match.rationale: Builds a real presentation navigator.credentials.get({digital}) call, pre-flights with the actual DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol() static, and correctly separates issuance (create) from presentation.

interactive.rationale: Send/cancel buttons drive a real credentials.get; the driven send honestly rejected with NotAllowedError (transient activation) and the page explained the rejection.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised assemble → pre-flight → explicit-send flow.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers activation-required rejection, cancellation, and the pre-flight-vs-send distinction without faking a wallet response.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 7 pass / 1 fail in this session.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: real send rejected NotAllowedError under a synthetic (non-activated) click and the page surfaced it verbatim with explanation; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: aria-live status region plus labelled inputs cover the request lifecycle.

openQuestions.title: Distinguish activation-loss from policy rejection in the send readout
openQuestions.detail: The rejection note already says the rejection alone does not identify the cause; adding a navigator.userActivation.isActive pre-check before send would let the page say definitively 'rejected because activation expired' vs 'blocked by policy' — a robustness nicety, since real user clicks carry activation.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: pre-flight reported userAgentAllowsProtocol available, real send rejected with 'NotAllowedError: requires transient activation' (synthetic click has none) and the page explained the ambiguity honestly; zero console errors; panel 7 pass / 1 fail.
